ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw report was ingested into the dashboard by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file from which this record was extracted

product_id.description: Product identifier from the DD/DAS interface (OData Id)

product_name.description: Product file name from the DD/DAS interface (OData Name)

content_length.description: Product file size in bytes (OData ContentLength)

publication_date.description: Date the product was published on the DD/DAS interface (OData PublicationDate)

origin_date.description: Product origin date at the source (OData OriginDate)

modification_date.description: Last modification date of the product on the DD/DAS interface (OData ModificationDate)

eviction_date.description: Date the product is scheduled to be evicted from the DD/DAS interface (OData EvictionDate)

interface_name.description: Name of the DD/DAS interface instance the product was collected from (DD_DAS)

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service providing the product (DD)

production_service_name.description: Name of the production service instance providing the product (DAS)
